name: LM Studio
summary: Zero-telemetry desktop GGUF runner that turns Apple Silicon or Windows/Linux GPUs into a private local model server.
ranking_rationale: Cleanest turnkey GUI for downloading and serving GGUF models; weighed against closed-source desktop binary despite local weights.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Cleanest turnkey GUI for downloading and serving GGUF models
Drop-in OpenAI-compatible localhost server for SillyTavern
Strict offline local execution with zero cloud logs
cons: Closed-source desktop binary despite local weights
No native roleplay character cards UI (pair with SillyTavern)
